title: 09 / Membrane: Infinite
sub: Another telling of 09 / Membrane, wide, on a mountain's summit torn up and floating in the void: two strokes, then the great one. Time all but stops as it lands; the hide turns to glass behind the struck point, onto an ocean's way down without end, veils of glowing dust between its rings, and the camera draws back round behind her to look into it past her. 24 seconds at 1920×1080, WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
